title: 4 Heart Health Protocols: light at night, social connection, sauna and biomarker monitoring
summary: A Blueprint blog post written by Vanessa Gibbs, not Bryan Johnson, covering heart health basics and four advanced protocols: limiting night light, social connection, regular sauna use and tracking blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar and ApoB. Bryan appears only in the third person, with a short note on his own sauna routine.
